note: Prices are conservative per-image estimates, rounded up, checked against each Fal model page on 2026-10-12; true spend shows on the Fal dashboard. sunburst is token-billed: the plain keys are Fal's published 1024x1024 rates and the @4k keys its 3840x2160 rates. The estimator gives a size of 1024x1024 or smaller the plain rate, and prices any larger size, or a run with no --size, at the @4k rate. Fal publishes no rate for large squares (2048x2048, 2880x2880), so the @4k rate is an unverified ceiling there. With no --quality forge sends and prices default_quality (medium), except finish, which uses high. auto is priced as max because the model picks the quality. Edit/style reuse the generation price; sunburst reference images bill extra image-input tokens ($8 per 1M) that the estimate does not include. The bg_remove (birefnet) price is an unverified conservative placeholder pending a Fal dashboard check. Update when Fal pricing changes.
